function.name: contracts-kb-mcp___knowledge_base_retrieve
function.description:
Retrieve source-grounded FoundryIQ/Caldova contract, SOW, quality agreement, rate-card, support-document, and policy evidence from the contracts knowledge base for contract-policy evidence tasks. Use this tool only for knowledge-plane retrieval: contract excerpts, SOW clauses, quality-agreement clauses, rate/pricing terms, policy requirements, document names, section titles, classifications, source references, effective-period/applicability evidence, support-document contents if available, and other provenance needed to ground an evidence packet. Do not use this tool to approve or reject invoices, reconcile invoices, make payment decisions, dispute charges, recommend payment disposition, write back to Waypoint, create cases, contact suppliers, or perform any business-system action.
Use this tool when the prompt does not already provide sufficient cited contract/policy evidence, when retrieved_context is absent, incomplete, not supplier-specific, missing source_ref/document/section/classification/text fields, missing governing-document applicability or effective-period support, missing pricing/rate support, or when additional grounding is needed for invoice-line audit, supplier-response preparation, controller evidence briefs, payment leakage risk review, variance review, minimum-evidence-for-approval analysis, or invoice reconciliation support. If the prompt already provides adequate cited excerpts with document, section, classification, source_ref, and text that are sufficient for the requested evidence-only response, answer from the provided evidence without calling this tool.
The typical task input is a strict JSON request containing invoice facts, a single invoice line, optional retrieved_context, supplier metadata, scenario/test metadata, negative constraints, and request style. Treat invoice fields such as invoice ID, line ID, supplier, invoice date, service period, purchase order ID, support references, line description, amount, quantity, unit price, reference ID, line type, and issue category as invoice facts only. Treat expected_decision_state, scenario_id, scenario_hint, reconciliation focus, risk examples, supplier specialty, supplier type, and other scenario metadata as routing/test context only, not as contract or policy evidence and not as a disposition.
Retrieved evidence should be used to produce evidence-only, provenance-separated outputs, commonly strict JSON when requested. Cite every factual contract/policy claim with the retrieved source_ref, document, section, and classification. Keep invoice facts, retrieved contract/policy evidence, supplier/scenario metadata, and scenario hints separate. Avoid uncited factual claims. Preserve advisory boundaries: set decision to null when asked not to decide, avoid approving/rejecting/reconciling/disputing as an action, avoid recommended finance action unless explicitly requested as non-decisional evidence support, and keep business_system_actions_performed as an empty array when no business-system action is allowed.
Maintain conditionality when clauses are conditional. A reference to a PO, purchase order, packaging order, QA packet, batch production record, batch release certificate, line-clearance log, deviation record, support document identifier, or release packet is not itself proof that the document contains the required authorization, release status, pricing, milestone, rate, volume, amount, service period, product/SKU linkage, batch linkage, or invoice-line linkage. If the underlying document contents are unavailable, identify open verification items such as confirming that the PO or written change authorization explicitly identifies the billed format, product, SKU, batch, milestone, service period, invoice date, reference ID, and amount/rate; confirming that support records actually link to the invoice line; confirming actual release status and dates; confirming whether the submission is a payment invoice or informational statement; confirming governing-document applicability and effective period; and confirming rate/pricing support.
When preparing an evidence packet, a high-quality response should generally include: invoice ID, line ID, supplier ID/name, issue category, line description and amount as invoice facts, an evidence assessment that is conditional rather than a finance decision, a basis summary grounded in cited excerpts, cited evidence objects with source_ref/document/section/classification/relevance, invoice facts used with field/value/relevance, open verification items, a controller review note, decision: null, no unsupported recommended finance action, and business_system_actions_performed: []. Good reasoning explicitly distinguishes identifiers from document contents, distinguishes invoice-stated status from independently verified status, states when pricing support is absent, and turns unresolved predicates into dated, record-specific reviewer checks.
Known domain patterns to retrieve and apply when relevant:

query.description: A concise, targeted search phrase describing the exact contract or policy evidence needed. Include supplier name or supplier ID, issue category, governing document type, clause topic, invoice ID, line ID, PO ID, batch/lot ID, packaging order ID, QA/release packet ID, service period, invoice date, and support identifiers when helpful. Prefer searches that ask for evidence sources, clauses, prerequisites, or support-document contents rather than decisions or conclusions. Do not ask the tool to approve, reject, reconcile, dispute, write back to Waypoint, create cases, contact suppliers, or make payment decisions. Effective examples include: cmo-001 Aster Ridge packaging authorization blister packaging purchase order written change authorization; Aster Ridge SOW section 3.2 packaging authorization blister surcharge standard bottle included unit production price; cmo-001 INV-CMO-001-2026-10-L004 PO-CMO-001-2026-10 PKG-AR-BLISTER-1026 blister packaging surcharge authorization pricing; invoice reconciliation policy minimum evidence for approval authorized source document supplier product SKU batch milestone material capacity period shipment line-level linkage; off_contract_packaging blister surcharge PO authorization pricing support PKG-AR-BLISTER-1026; cmo-002 Northstar Fill Finish quality agreement pending batches may not be invoiced batch manufacturing QA release line clearance; quality-release billability policy pending batches informational statements payment approval release contract-defined milestone; Northstar pending QA status batch fee release certificate line clearance deviation record billability; cmo-002 INV-CMO-002-2026-10-L004 BATCH-NS-1026-02 NFF-REL-1026 LC-NFF-1026 DEV-NFF-1026-07 pending release status support linkage; and pricing rate card SOW batch manufacturing QA release fee Northstar 348000 service period 2026-10.
